label: bug
title: TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined when opening settings
body: After upgrading to 3.2.0, opening the settings page throws TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'theme'). Worked fine on 3.1.4. Chrome 125, macOS.

label: bug
title: Memory usage grows unbounded with websocket reconnects
body: Our worker leaks ~40MB/hour when the upstream websocket flaps. Heap snapshots show retained closures in the reconnect handler. Repro: kill the upstream every 30s and watch RSS.

label: feature
title: Support YAML configuration in addition to JSON
body: It would be great if the CLI accepted config.yaml. JSON has no comments and our configs are getting large. Happy to contribute a PR if maintainers are open to it.

label: question
title: How do I configure retry backoff for the HTTP client?
body: I read the docs but couldn't find how to change the default backoff. Is there an env var or do I need to subclass the client?

label: docs
title: Installation guide missing pnpm instructions
body: The README only shows npm and yarn. pnpm users have to guess. Suggest adding a pnpm tab to the install section.

label: bug
title: Race condition: duplicate jobs executed when two workers start simultaneously
body: When scaling from 0 to 2 replicas, both workers occasionally pick up the same scheduled job. Looks like the SELECT ... FOR UPDATE is missing SKIP LOCKED. v1.9.2, Postgres 15.

label: feature
title: Add --json flag to the status command
body: We want to consume status output in scripts. A machine-readable JSON output mode would remove our brittle regex parsing.

label: question
title: Is multi-region deployment supported?
body: We need data residency in the EU. Can the service run active-active across regions, or is it single-region only? Couldn't find anything in the docs.

label: docs
title: Typo: 'recieve' in webhook documentation
body: docs/webhooks.md line 42 spells 'receive' as 'recieve'. Tiny, but it shows up in search.

label: bug
title: CSV export drops rows containing commas inside quoted fields
body: Exporting a table where a cell contains 'Smith, John' silently drops the row. Expected proper RFC 4180 quoting. Version 2.4.1, repro file attached.

label: feature
title: Dark mode for the dashboard
body: Late-night ops would appreciate a dark theme. Even just respecting prefers-color-scheme would help.

label: bug
title: Segfault in native parser on malformed UTF-8 input
body: Feeding 0xC3 0x28 to parse() crashes the process with SIGSEGV instead of raising. ASAN trace attached. Affects 0.8.0 through 0.8.3 on Linux x86_64.

label: question
title: Difference between flush() and commit()?
body: The API has both flush and commit and the docstrings are nearly identical. When should I use which? Asking after a confusing data-loss scare in staging.

label: docs
title: Architecture diagram is outdated after the queue migration
body: docs/architecture.png still shows RabbitMQ but the code moved to Redis streams in v3.0. New contributors keep getting confused.

label: bug
title: Login redirect loop when SSO session expires mid-request
body: Steps: 1. log in via Okta 2. let the session expire 3. click any link. Browser bounces between /login and /callback forever. v5.1.0, also seen on 5.0.x.

label: feature
title: Expose Prometheus metrics endpoint
body: We'd like /metrics with request counts, latency histograms, and queue depth so we can alert without log scraping.

label: bug
title: Timezone off by one hour in scheduled reports after DST change
body: Since the DST switch, daily reports arrive at 09:00 instead of 08:00 UTC+1. Scheduler appears to cache the offset at boot. v4.2.0 on Debian 12.

label: question
title: Can I use this library with Deno?
body: The docs mention Node 18+ only. Has anyone run it under Deno's Node compat layer? Any known blockers?

label: feature
title: Bulk delete API for stale records
body: Deleting records one-by-one is too slow for our nightly cleanup of ~200k rows. A batch endpoint with a filter would cut our maintenance window dramatically.

label: docs
title: Add migration guide from v2 to v3
body: The v3 changelog lists breaking changes but there's no step-by-step migration path. A guide covering the config format change and renamed CLI flags would save everyone hours.

label: bug
title: File descriptor leak when TLS handshake fails
body: Each failed handshake leaves a socket in CLOSE_WAIT. After ~4k failures we hit EMFILE and the server stops accepting. lsof output attached. v1.12.1.

label: question
title: Recommended way to test handlers that use the client?
body: Should I mock the client, spin up the docker fixture, or is there an in-memory mode for unit tests? What do the maintainers do internally?

label: feature
title: Webhook retries with exponential backoff
body: Currently a single failed delivery is dropped. We'd like configurable retries with backoff and a dead-letter list, similar to what Stripe does.

label: bug
title: Pagination cursor breaks when items are deleted between pages
body: Fetching page 2 after deleting an item from page 1 skips a record. Offset-based pagination under the hood? Expected stable cursors. API v2, observed on 2024-05 snapshot.

label: docs
title: Document the rate limits for the public API
body: We got 429s in production and only then discovered limits exist. Please document the per-key and per-IP limits and the Retry-After semantics.

label: bug
title: Crash on startup when config file contains BOM
body: config.json saved by Notepad with UTF-8 BOM makes the parser throw 'Unexpected token \ufeff'. Expected: tolerate or clearly report BOM. v3.3.0, Windows 11.

label: feature
title: Allow custom S3 endpoint for MinIO compatibility
body: We self-host MinIO. Hardcoded AWS endpoint means we can't use the storage backend. An S3_ENDPOINT_URL setting is all we need.

label: question
title: Why does the build require Python even for the JS package?
body: npm install fails on machines without Python. Is that node-gyp? Is there a prebuilt binary option? Trying to slim our CI image.

label: bug
title: Incorrect total count in search results when filters combine
body: Searching with status:open AND label:bug shows 'about 1,200 results' but only 87 are returned and paging ends at 87. The count ignores the second filter. Web UI, build 2024.11.2.

label: docs
title: Example in quickstart uses removed function create_app_legacy
body: Quickstart step 3 calls create_app_legacy() which was removed in 4.0. New users hit ImportError on their first run. Should be create_app().
